name: claude-dj
description: Control YouTube Music, Spotify or anything else playing from Claude Code: a now-playing band, /play /pause /next /prev /vol, Spotify search, play, queue and like, and music tools for Claude

showBand.title: Now-playing band
showBand.description: Show the track and controls above the prompt (off: a status line entry instead)

volumeStep.title: Volume step
volumeStep.description: How many percent the band's + and - buttons and /vol up and down move the volume

spotifyClientId.title: Spotify Client ID
spotifyClientId.description: Client ID of your app at developer.spotify.com (Redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43117/callback); enables /spotify and the Spotify tools

musicTools.title: Music tools for Claude
musicTools.description: Let Claude see what is playing and play, pause or skip when you ask it to
